verdict.line: You lose if Camille cashes in an E (Hookshot)-into-R all-in before level 9 while your Q stacks are thin; you win if you survive to Trinity Force with enough stacks that your sustained damage outpaces her shield-and-mobility kit.

brief.thesis: The head-to-head is essentially even at 49.8% over 1624 games, but that number hides a timing split: Camille holds the lane and solo-kill edge early because her E (Hookshot) plus Q (Precision Protocol) empowered autos force fights on her terms, while Nasus's Q (Siphoning Strike) stacking is a slow-building snowball that only outweighs her once items land. The whole matchup is a race between her kill windows and your stack curve.

theirWindow.when: she lands E (Hookshot) off a nearby wall
theirWindow.what: The knockup chains into an empowered Q (Precision Protocol) auto and, at level 6+, R (The Hextech Ultimatum) anchoring you in place. Once E connects you're committed to the fight, so Wither her the instant she starts the windup to blunt the follow-up speed and damage.

yourWindow.when: her E (Hookshot) is on cooldown or no wall is in range
yourWindow.what: She has no clean engage tool for 16/15/14/13/12 seconds, so push freely, farm Q stacks off casters and cannon minions, and drop E (Spirit Fire) on the wave to shred her Armor for the next trade.

start.why: The 69.1%-picked, 48.8% WR start that gives the sustain and early trade durability you need to survive her empowered autos while you farm stacks.

boots.why: Best-performing boots in the data (53.3% WR) — the cooldown reduction tightens your Q (Siphoning Strike) stacking tempo and keeps W (Wither) up more often to blunt her mobility.

core.why: Anchors the highest-winrate build path (57.7% over 222 games) and gives the damage/attack-speed spike that turns stacked Q into real duel pressure.
Armor and attack-speed slow directly counter her auto-attack-reliant Q/passive combo and the follow-up damage from The Hextech Ultimatum.
Stacks sustain on top of your passive Soul Eater lifesteal, letting you outlast her Adaptive Defenses shield in extended trades.

situational.when: she's building into crit or heavy on-hit and her autos are doing most of the damage
you want the alternate core path into Frozen Heart and Spirit Visage for earlier teamfight utility
you're losing early trades and need cheap armor plus antiheal against her W (Tactical Sweep) healing
her empowered Q autos are the dominant source of your damage taken in lane

runes.keystoneWhy: Highest-performing page in the data (48.8% WR, 49.9% pick) — the sustain and move speed proc help you dodge her E (Hookshot) windup and offset her early trade advantage.

summoners.why: Flash+Ghost posts the best measured winrate in this matchup (53.8% over 25.2% pick share) — Flash dodges her E (Hookshot) commitment and Ghost lets you disengage or chase once Wither is on her. Flash+Teleport (48.7%) is the alternate if you want wave-state flexibility instead.

playing.title: Track her E cooldown
playing.detail: Camille's E (Hookshot) is a dash to a wall on a 16/15/14/13/12s cooldown — she can't all-in without it up and a wall in range, so push the moment it's down.

playing.title: Stack Q on casters
playing.detail: Prioritize killing blows with Q (Siphoning Strike) on casters and cannon minions over winning every trade; the stack curve matters more than early lane damage.

playing.title: Wither before she commits
playing.detail: Cast W (Wither) the instant she starts her E windup or steps in — it decelerates her Movement and Attack Speed over time and dulls the extra damage from her empowered Q (Precision Protocol) auto.

playing.title: Respect the level 6-8 all-in
playing.detail: Once R (The Hextech Ultimatum) is up she can dash onto you from 475 range and anchor the fight — this is her biggest kill window per the data, so play passive through it.

playing.title: Burn the wave with E
playing.detail: Drop E (Spirit Fire) on the lane when she's melee-trading so the Armor reduction hits her too, cheapening your stacking trades.

playing.title: Scale into Trinity Force
playing.detail: The 57.7% WR build path (Trinity Force into Frozen Heart into Spirit Visage) is your power spike — once it's online, stacked Q outpaces her Adaptive Defenses shield sustain.

playing.title: Save R for forced extended fights
playing.detail: Fury of the Sands (R, 120s cooldown) drains nearby max Health into bonus damage while buffing your Health and range — hold it for fights she can't disengage from with E, not to open.

brief.patchCaveat: Build paths, winrates, and pick rates above are measured from live OP.GG games on the current patch; the tactical reading of ability timings, cooldowns, and trade patterns is my own analysis of the kit.

stats.opponentTip: It is important to avoid Camille’s (E) ability. Focus foremost on raising your [Q] stacks, and use Unsealed Spellbook + Fury of the Sands [R] to counterplay when Camille’s abilities are on cooldown to gain lane control.
